chapter: Trent's band: touring, sidemen and breakup
title: Leslie Sheffield and Fuqua on the last records
summary: Sheffield played tuba and piano; Charlie Fuqua travelled with the band to the end.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: And then later on--I talked to Leslie Sheffield out in Oklahoma City and Leslie told me that when he was in high school he booked the band to play some dances, some high school dances or something out there. This must have been the time that he came in--he came in the band as a tuba player and also played piano, too. This is when Trent was in the band because he was supposed to be on this last record.
He is. It's got on here Eugene Crooke, R. Leslie Sheffield.
That's not right, because Sheffield didn't play guitar, he played tuba.
It probably wouldn't be Crooke; it would probably be Claude Williamson, or Charlie
Fuqua. Fuqua never actually played with the band. They travelled with the band; didn't they? He travelled with us. Fuqua was with the band when the band broke up.
